definition: num / (den + 8), where num = sum over mapped query places whose pair the frozen estimator can judge of (plus_score - 0.5), and den = the number of query places that carry a graded incident relation (a property of the graph, not of the mapping)

fitted_on.gallery: 2 objects per class, 16 items, reference view -000-000, query view -022-000
fitted_on.objective: mean rank-1 over T1, T2, T3

note: The lambda grid is FLAT over 0.5-1.5 and the mean rank-1 moves by one query between neighbouring grid points (0.512 to 0.533 is 1/48 query-tasks). The optimum is interior, so the registered rule (a boundary optimum is not a fit) does not fire and lambda = 1.0 is carried forward unchanged; but the reader should treat the value as ONE QUERY wide, which is why Mission 21 is registered with its MDE stated rather than with a claim.
